note: Presets are starting points every brand can pick. Channel defaults are rules of thumb, not platform rules. Rewrite them in your own words.

archetypes.name: The Trusted Guide
archetypes.description: We explain before we sell. We sound calm, clear and sure of our facts, and we admit what we don't know. People come to us to understand, then decide.

archetypes.name: The Straight Talker
archetypes.description: We say it plainly and get to the point. We name the price, the catch and the trade-off before anyone has to ask. No fluff, no hype.

archetypes.name: The Good Friend
archetypes.description: We sound like someone you'd text for advice: warm, easy to read, a little funny and always on your side. We never talk down.

archetypes.name: The Expert
archetypes.description: We know this field deeply and it shows in the details. We are precise, we cite what we can and we explain the why. Confident, never showy.

archetypes.name: The Challenger
archetypes.description: We question how things are usually done in our category and say so. Bold and a little provocative, always with a better way to offer.

archetypes.name: The Maker
archetypes.description: We love the craft behind what we make. We show our work, name the materials and the steps, and take pride in small details.

archetypes.name: The Carer
archetypes.description: We put people's comfort first. Gentle, patient and reassuring, we make hard things feel manageable.

archetypes.name: The Explorer
archetypes.description: We are always looking for what's next and we bring people along. Curious, energetic and happy to try things first.

archetypes.name: The Entertainer
archetypes.description: We make people smile while we make our point. Playful, quick and surprising, never at the customer's expense.

archetypes.name: The Refined
archetypes.description: We say less and choose every word. Calm, polished and understated: quality shows without being announced.

archetypes.name: The Encourager
archetypes.description: We believe people can do more than they think, and we show them how. Upbeat and practical about the next step.

archetypes.name: The Community Builder
archetypes.description: We talk with people, not at them. We ask questions, spotlight customers and share the mic.

traits.name: Direct
traits.sounds_like: We get to the point and say the hard part first.

traits.name: Honest
traits.sounds_like: We name the trade-offs and say what we can't do.

traits.name: Warm
traits.sounds_like: We sound like a person who's glad you're here.

traits.name: Playful
traits.sounds_like: We enjoy words and leave room for a smile.
traits.does_not_mean: Silly, or jokey about serious things.

traits.name: Witty
traits.sounds_like: A sharp turn of phrase makes the point stick.

traits.name: Calm
traits.sounds_like: Steady and unhurried, even when the topic is urgent.

traits.name: Bold
traits.sounds_like: We take a clear stand and say it with conviction.

traits.name: Confident
traits.sounds_like: We state what we know without hedging.
traits.does_not_mean: Boastful, or unwilling to admit limits.

traits.name: Curious
traits.sounds_like: We ask why, test things and share what we learn.

traits.name: Expert
traits.sounds_like: We explain the why, with detail only a specialist would know.

traits.name: Precise
traits.sounds_like: Exact numbers, exact words, no padding.

traits.name: Practical
traits.sounds_like: Every post leaves people with a next step they can take.

traits.name: Reassuring
traits.sounds_like: We lower the stakes and make it feel doable.

traits.name: Caring
traits.sounds_like: We notice how people feel and respond to it.

traits.name: Down-to-earth
traits.sounds_like: Everyday words and real examples, no airs.

traits.name: Optimistic
traits.sounds_like: We look for what can go right and show how to get there.

traits.name: Inspiring
traits.sounds_like: We show people what's possible for them.

traits.name: Energetic
traits.sounds_like: Short sentences, active verbs, momentum.
traits.does_not_mean: Shouty, or full of exclamation marks.

traits.name: Thoughtful
traits.sounds_like: We take a moment to say something worth reading.

traits.name: Inclusive
traits.sounds_like: We write so everyone feels the post is for them.
traits.does_not_mean: Bland, or afraid to take a view.

traits.name: Refined
traits.sounds_like: Understated and polished, every word chosen.

traits.name: Quirky
traits.sounds_like: An unexpected angle you'd only get from us.

traits.name: Rebellious
traits.sounds_like: We question our category's habits out loud.

traits.name: Humble
traits.sounds_like: We credit others and let results speak.

do_and_dont.do: Use them: we're, it's, you'll.
do_and_dont.dont: Stiff phrasing: we are pleased to inform you.

do_and_dont.do: Concrete details: the number, the place, the time.
do_and_dont.dont: Vague praise: fast, reliable, quality.

do_and_dont.do: Write to you: you'll see the difference in a week.
do_and_dont.dont: Talk about customers: customers may see results.

do_and_dont.do: Start from their problem, in their words.
do_and_dont.dont: Start from us: our innovative formula.

do_and_dont.do: Words a customer would use out loud.
do_and_dont.dont: Industry terms they'd have to look up.

do_and_dont.do: Say who did it: we fixed the bug.
do_and_dont.dont: Hide who did it: the bug has been resolved.

do_and_dont.do: One idea per sentence.
do_and_dont.dont: Sentences that carry three ideas at once.

do_and_dont.do: One at most, and only when it's earned.
do_and_dont.dont: Big news!!!

do_and_dont.do: Only when they add meaning, 2 at most.
do_and_dont.dont: An emoji after every line.

do_and_dont.do: 3 at most, specific to the topic.
do_and_dont.dont: A wall of hashtags.

do_and_dont.do: Digits: 3 steps, 40% less.
do_and_dont.dont: Vague amounts: a few steps, much less.

do_and_dont.do: Say what we tested and how.
do_and_dont.dont: Promise results we can't show: proven, guaranteed.

do_and_dont.do: The price and what's included, up front.
do_and_dont.dont: A from-price, with the catch in small print.

do_and_dont.do: Compare on facts, or not at all.
do_and_dont.dont: Naming or mocking competitors.

do_and_dont.do: Light, and about the situation.
do_and_dont.dont: Jokes at the customer's expense.

do_and_dont.do: One clear next step.
do_and_dont.dont: Three different asks in one post.

do_and_dont.do: Sentence case: How we make it.
do_and_dont.dont: Title Case: How We Make It.

do_and_dont.do: British English, always: colour, organise.
do_and_dont.dont: Mixing colour and color.

do_and_dont.do: Everyone, people, team.
do_and_dont.dont: Guys, manpower.

do_and_dont.do: Real deadlines only: ends Sunday.
do_and_dont.dont: Pressure that isn't true: only a few left!!!

do_and_dont.do: Everyday words our customers use.
do_and_dont.dont: Trendy slang we'd never say out loud.
